sentences.text:
Shri Shyamlal Patidar - Advocate for the Advocate.
 Shri Surendra Singh Alawa-GA appearing on behalf of Ad
1] They are heard and perused the case diary.

2] This is the applicant's first bail application filed under Section 483 of B.N.S.S./ 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, as he / she is implicated in connection with Crime No.251/2023 registered at Police Station Katthiwada District Alirajpur for offence punishable under Sections 420, 409, 120-B,
467, 468, 471 of IPC and section 74 of the I.T.Act and section 13(A) (B) of Prevention of Corruption Act.
The applicant is in custody since 25.11.2025.

3] Allegation against the applicant is that he was involved in the aforesaid case wherein the present applicant, along with other co-accused persons have misappropriated Government fund to the tune of Rs.20,47,12,727/-, which was meant for the purpose of meeting the school expenses.

4] Counsel for the applicant, at the outset, has submitted that similarly situated co-accused Deepak has already been granted bail by this Court in M.Cr.C.
No.57359 of 2025 dated 29.12.2025, and the case of the present applicant is identical to that of co-accused Deepak.

5] Counsel for the applicant has further submitted that other co-accused persons namely Shyam Rathore, Vikas Rathore, Sapnesh Rathore Kamal NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-IND:320 2 MCRC-60650-2025 Rathore, Virendra, Nitesh Rathore have already been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 13.2.2024, 13.2.2024, 16.2.2024. 27.2.2024, 13.8.2024,
6.8.2025 passed in MCRC.No.4078/2024, MCRC.No. 4088/2024 MCRC.No. 4081/2024,
MCRC.No.8168/2024, MCRC.No.30917/2024 and MCRC No.30543/2025 respectively.

It is further submitted that the applicant is lodged in jail since 25.11.2025 and the conclusion of trial will take Dinesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73819359/

sentences.text: sufficienty long time, thus, it is prayed that on the ground of parity, present application be also allowed.
6] Counsel for the State has opposed the prayer, however, it is not denied that co-accused Deepak has already been granted bail.
7] On due consideration of submissions and on perusal of the case-diary as also the order passed in M.Cr.C. No.57359/2025, this Court is inclined to allow the present application.
8] Accordingly, maintaining parity, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is hereby allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum o f Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
9] Accordingly, the application is allowed and disposed of.
